discovery_log.topic: Free/open OSE/SGX intraday data for Dynamic Price Discovery
findings: 225Labo is the strongest no-extra-cost OSE minute-data candidate but requires free member login and personal-use-only terms.
JPX J-GATE ITCH is authoritative but paid and external distribution is prohibited; rejected under current cost policy.
No clearly licensed, freely downloadable venue-specific OSE/SGX minute dataset was found through GitHub repository search in this pass.
Open GitHub Nikkei minute datasets found are index/CFD proxies rather than OSE futures and cannot validate DPD venue leadership.
discovery_log.next_action: Prepare cloud ingestion adapter and wait for an approved personally licensed OSE source; meanwhile continue proxy/state research without promotion.

findings: FutureSharks JPXJPY minute data is pinned to an immutable Git commit for cloud reproducibility.
HistData timestamps are fixed EST UTC-5 without DST; JNU workflow converts deterministically to JST.
First volatility proxy test is preregistered at 5-minute frequency, Japan cash sessions only, HAR windows 1/5/22.
JNU Micro minute data is free for registered members but download requires login.
Micro minute coverage begins 2023-07-24; 1/3/5/10/15/20/30/60 minute files are offered.
Night-session dates follow OSE next-trading-day labeling.
GitHub Actions formal ingestion is blocked until user-authorized account/credential handling and private-storage terms are resolved.
SPXUSD minute files 2011-2018 are available in the same pinned FutureSharks repository.
Fixed EST timestamps must be converted to America/New_York to restore daylight-saving-aware cash hours.
Proxy G0 selects the most recent completed U.S. cash session strictly before Japan open to prevent look-ahead.
J-Quants API minute/tick add-on covers equities only and explicitly excludes derivatives such as futures.
JPX historical derivatives tick and one-minute OHLC are paid Market Data Service / DataCube products; not approved under the no-extra-cost policy.
JPX daily participant-volume archives are public, but the post-2023 daily disclosure combines buys and sells; it does not provide a directional net-flow signal.
Monthly participant reports separate buys and sells but are too coarse to serve as the intended intraday/daily JNU order-imbalance factor.
Do not proxy order imbalance from OHLC/VWAP/volume bars.
discovery_log.next_action: Keep true order-imbalance research in the literature layer until an approved venue-level trade/order-side dataset is available.

findings: Download approval terms state the data is for the individual user's learning to improve market-trading ability and may not be used for other purposes including commercial use.
Nikkei mini/micro pages state use is licensed only to the person who downloaded the data and prohibit provision/sale or similar acts to third parties.
Therefore raw cloud upload/processing through third-party infrastructure is not treated as approved.
Safest architecture is local raw download/processing and cloud persistence of only non-reconstructive derived features/results with provenance.
Cboe LTV is explicitly designed by Torben Andersen and Viktor Todorov and its methodology cites the 2021 Japanese-equity tail-risk paper.
LTV targets risk-neutral volatility from >=10-standard-deviation downside SPX moves over one week using short-expiry deep OTM puts.
Official methodology gives base date 2006-01-03 and launch date 2024-03-14, suggesting back-calculated history may exist.
No free official bulk historical-download route has yet been verified; therefore no backtest is authorized.
SKEW is not treated as an equivalent substitute.
discovery_log.next_action: Verify historical LTV end-of-day access and terms before preregistering any tail-risk proxy test.

findings: 225Labo confirms Nikkei 225 mini minute data from 2006-07-18 onward.
Micro minute history begins in 2023, which is too short to be the sole multi-regime confirmation sample.
Use frozen Nikkei mini long history first, then Micro as exact-product recent consistency/forward confirmation.
Raw 225Labo data remains local-only under the previously recorded personal-use policy.
